summary: A scale-free extension of the exact-rank-one recoloring E3 floor to an arbitrarily thin Frobenius rank-one tube is false. With child internal blocks C=D=I2 and outer blocks U=diag(1/epsilon,epsilon), V=diag(epsilon,1/epsilon), the outer coupling is O(epsilon)-close to one rank-one global block, but the recolored cross matrix [[I,U],[V,I]] has rank two and E3=0 because VU=I. The construction embeds into a symmetric target-valid matrix with a 4x4 principal child spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}. This refutes only the perturbative recoloring step, not QFORM. The exact-rank-one theorem remains valid and gives E3>=7c^6/2 before the diffuse-volume/bicolop dichotomy.
